notes.title: Update v5.9.3h
notes.content:
[p]I've been having a really hectic few days settling issues from the new login system as well as making sure that the Brazil service is operating the best it can. I am working closely with our hosting partner in Brazil to see how we can further improve it.[/p][p]We've also added a new MongoDB read cluster in Brazil to improve login, mail, guild systems and more features that depend on read-only information access.[/p][p]Balance changes from the results of the recent survey are coming soon.[/p][p][/p][h2]Content[/h2][list][*][p][b]Added Pink Cowboy Hat to the event prize shop[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Servers now select the MongoDB cluster closest to them
[/b]This along with new clusters for Sao Paulo means Brazil service will benefit from faster login times and more![/p][/*][*][p][b]Chatbox styling changes
[/b]Made the chatbox completely transparent when not in use, to keep more focus on the game and less on UI. Changed the color of the scrollbar to match the rest of the chatbox. Improved the amount of text that can be displayed in it and the text wrapping to be more accurate.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minimap size slightly decreased when not maximized
[/b]It was taking up slightly too much space. Also, reduced the amount of blurring on the minimap substantially.[/p][/*][*][p][b]If items are on the floor on the same tile as a player, it will now prioritize the player[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]The ladder in the Ship now works[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Balancing[/h2][list][*][p][b]Reverted Needle Blade back to its previous state [/b](Yes, it snares again)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Needle Blade bonus fortitude reduced from 20 to 10[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Needle Blade now snares for 0.6s[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Thunder Blades attack speed changed from 2.3s to 1.8[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Fixed multiple weapons and jutsus descriptions to match their actual damage values[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Many bug fixes for the new Steam login system[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixes to logout/saving[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed HTTPWebServer[/b] (unused dependency)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Login optimizations for Brazil[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimizations to Housing, Guilds, Mail systems for Brazil server[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed a crafting exploit[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Gracefully shutdown Steam Server API on server shutdown[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed a server error to do with missing maps and NPC Buffs[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed another lag spike caused by recent changes[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed clan leaders able to affect furniture in village spaces instead of clan houses[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Made Clan Noticeboard use local time for Clan leader selection date/time[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed Equipment buffs not re-casting on player when they respawn after fainting[/b][/p][/*][*][p](Hopefully) [b]Fixed buddy removal bug where players buddies disappear constantly after being removed once[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed Name Changer and Steam Character Creation allowing for names that are too long[/b][/p][/*][/list]

[p]This update comes with some cool features, engine updates that will make the game work better for everyone, as well as a new experimental event mode - Team Deathmatches!

Expect your game to run smoother and for the game server to handle more players better. The engine updates bring about upgrades to the underlying technology of the game to ensure Nin Online continues to be modern long into the future.[/p][p][/p][h2]Content[/h2][list][*][p][b]Added High Level Suwa and Muteki Clan Equipment to their Clan Shops[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/baffb6184b6c47edfe4ccc4de1a9d36295b82e7c.png"][/img][/p][p]Art commissioned by players, done by Luhan & Genshin[/p][/*][/list][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]Added New EXP Orbs Animation System[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/21734635987255f6d7185bdbd77ecd0f4c81ff98.gif"][/img][/p][p]When you defeat NPCs, EXP Orbs will appear on the map. When they are collected, you will gain experience. They will automatically be absorbed by you even if you don't walk on them - and don't worry, you will never lose EXP for not collecting them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Experimental Team Deathmatch Event mode[/b][/p][p]Players are assigned into separate teams (Blue/Red) and fight it out until the set amount of kills is reached or the time ends. Reviving players during the time removes 1 kill off the enemy team's score. This is still work in progress and a lot of polish is still required, but we will test it out with players over the next couple of days![/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Guide & Rules buttons to "More Menu" in HUD
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/9640e934275995d9f7e623f6569809bc80c5d0ae.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Regional/Localized Pricing Capabilities to Engine to support better localization[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Players can now see Guild Listing while in a guild[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added support for Decimal Cast Times for Techniques[/b][/p][p]All this while, it was impossible to add jutsu that had less than 1s cast time. It was either 0, 1 or 2 seconds. Now it can be 0.5s, 1.2s, 2.8s etc.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Recommended Server in Server Selection
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/ed046f89863d9e7b2e20b66e547295e117672231.png"][/img][/p][p]The client now pings the server to find which of the servers available is most suitable for you.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added messages sent to the chatbox to notify you your proficiency level has increased[/b][/p][/*][*][p](Dev) [b]Added setting to make Water-only NPCs[/b][/p][/*][*][p](Dev) [b]Added setting to disable transforming into certain NPCs[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Removed OpenTK from the Game Client[/b][/p][p]This was a huge hurdle in supporting older hardware, as we needed to initialize a OpenTK window to support ImGUI. But we've rewritten the engine to not require OpenTK to use ImGUI at all! This means that people who were previously using 3rd Party Software (Mesa3D) to emulate newer OpenGL versions should no longer need to do so. Nin Online's client should now way more older devices. This change also comes with performance improvements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nin Online Client Upgraded from .NET 6 to .NET 8[/b][/p][p]We will reap the benefits such as improved performance and better cross-platform compatibility. This upgrade gives us major runtime, JIT, and GC performance improvements as .NET 6 support by windows ended on November 12, 2024.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nin Online Server Upgraded from .NET 5 to .NET 8[/b][/p][p]This should make the server faster at processing json data, as well as generally improve server performance as we benefit from updated technology improvements. As .NET 5 support by windows ended on May 10, 2022, this also restores long-term support and security patches by Windows.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The game no longer changes your target if your jutsu hits another enemy[/b][/p][p]If you already have a target, it's going to assume you want to keep that target now. This used to have very unintended consequences, like if your Great Fireball Technique hit an enemy while you were chasing your current target, it selected that person it hit instead. If you don't have a target, it will target that enemy.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added exit on Takumi Village Hospital Roof[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Replaced Purple Bandana Protector Icon to more appropriate icon[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Level Range Exclusive Bosses Unlocked[/b][/p][p]Manda (now renamed Hebimaru) and Kumoroi Boss are now unlocked for all levels past their level range, but you must do them solo.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tanzaku Quarters renamed to Kinsen Quarters[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed Headband Selection from Ninja Menu[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added better Guild Logging[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Balancing[/h2][list][*][p][b]Ninja Tools Rebalancing[/b][/p][p]Rebalanced Kunai, Senbon and Shuriken to use 50% Stat Scaling (Same as all Techniques) and increased base damage from 0 to 20 This increases the amount of damage ninjas do substantially up until stat 200, which means it's essentially a buff for tools, especially on lower levels. notes.title: Update v5.8.9
notes.content:
[p]Another day another bunch of feature drops...!

This update comes with a bunch of small features as well as fixes to existing ones. We're in the middle of some important balance changes being planned. The balance survey is still on-going if you would like to provide feedback regarding the state of balance. This directly impacts how the game is balanced![/p][p][url="https://ninonline.com/survey" style="button" buttoncolor="#f58300"]Nin Online Balance Survey[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Content[/h2][list][*][p][b]Added Black Katahada Kimono to the Cash Shop [/b](Amazing art by Jiang)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Rat Pal to the Cash Shop[/b] (Thank you Hyach for the art)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added /shh emoticon[/b] (Good job Luhan!)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance[/h2][list][*][p][b]Blood Tonfa attack speed adjusted from 0.6s to 0.8s[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Blood Tonfa Base Damage increased from 36 to 40[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]Headband Selection[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/4b7bd39ced633a5595dd9e3044226d380461db45.png"][/img]This has been one of the earliest systems that was hackily added into the game. We've added it as a proper feature where players who graduate the academy can now select a headband from a table in the academy. Once you have chosen it, you can come back at anytime to switch it out.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Defame Button added to fainted screen
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/2cffb97e83ac1d5721ec7c4bbd1ecacb9945c6df.png"][/img][/p][p]Players who are killed in combat are now prompted if they want to defame their killer. This is yet another feature in a long line of planned features to combat the habit players killing others for no reason, while retaining the core design philosophy of a sandbox MMORPG where you can do it - but why?[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Equipment is now viewable by others when they right click you
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/b8911c797f2355559e11cc09fef69a3d8470ba18.png"][/img][b]
[/b]There's a new tab in the Right-click menu of players that allows you to view what the other player has equipped. notes.title: Update v5.8.5e
notes.content:
[p][b]RE: Balancing Phase[/b][/p][p]For transparency, the plan now is that for the next week there won’t be anymore major changes to balance, just small tweaks here and there and fixes.[/p][p]This will be followed up with a mini survey purely dedicated to balance, asking more in-depth questions than even the usual surveys.[/p][p]Based on those survey results and observations over the next week, I’ll be making more changes again and expect there to be free stat resets again.[/p][p]Expect this to repeat again potentially after, until we reach the most balanced state Nin Online has ever seen.[/p][p]I understand this has been the longest most comprehensive balancing period for the game in years, but this is completely necessary going forward to get the game in a good stable state to then expand on content. I am aiming for the introduction of level 70 level cap raise within the next couple of months.

I appreciate the patience from everyone![/p][h2][/h2][h2]Content[/h2][list][*][p][b]Added Village Inns
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/19c478dc45c4aa3fc75a2bc34fcb701c8247acb4.png"][/img]720 New Units of Player Housing Added Village Inns can hold up to 180 player rooms per floor and one floor has been added to each village for now![/p][/*][*][p](GMs) [b]Updated GM Room[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p](Devs) [b]Map Editor Create Brush from Map
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/db073f2f931c5005977acb4be57ea4982615d94f.gif"][/img]Map Editor now allows for Shift + Dragging on the map to copy the tiles on the map to be used as a brush. Also, improved outlines for tile brushes.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Added new swear words to chat filter[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Council Members will now be able to select Kage as long as there isn't one[/b] (Pending server restart)
This is part of an coming feature for performing a coup[/p][/*][*][p][b]Turning off Dynamic Weather is now deprecated
[/b]Weather does not have a significant impact on frame rate as it did when the feature was added in the old client. Since then, it's just served as a way for players to get more visibility when there is weather effects going on. It becomes disadvantageous to not turn it on for better vision and ruin the game's graphics. notes.title: Update v5.8.5
notes.content:
[p]This update brings about a bunch of much needed bug fixes, polishing, as well as new community engagement features.[/p][p]This also brings more graphics done by the community art team that I've been working with to be more organized with the help of Luhan. Thank you to Luhan, Kloyd, Jiang, Fuze, Genshin, Princess and Slugnir for actively working on art for the game![/p][p][/p][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]Discord Notifications for In-Game Happenings
[/b]This is a cool community engagement feature to keep people who are currently outside offline updated on what's going on in the Ninja World. You can join our [url="https://ninonline.com/discord"]Official Nin Online Discord Server[/url] and subscribe to the [url="https://discord.com/channels/615663613822238731/1403787093406384269"]#toad-news[/url][b] [/b]channel to find out when these things happen...[/p][list][*][p]Blessings[/p][/*][*][p]Maps Captured[/p][/*][*][p]Tournaments/Events[/p][/*][*][p]Maintenances Scheduled[/p][/*][*][p]Players reach Max Level[/p][/*][*][p]Elections Begin & Results[/p][/*][*][p]Dailies Reset[/p][/*][/list][p]I'm open to hearing what else you'd like to be notified about on Discord![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Hand Signs animation
[/b]Some jutsu will now have the character actually perform hand signs during the cast time of the jutsu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Sound Effects to Chakra Charging and Hand Seal Jutsu Animation
[/b]This is just a small polish that has been sorely missing[/p][/*][*][p][b]Action Prompt HUD
[/b]Can be disabled in the settings, but this will be helpful to remind new players what is interactable[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map Links Display HUD
[/b]Map edge warps now display when getting close to edges of maps[/p][/*][*][p](Devs)[b] Animation Editor References Tab
[/b]Just like the Item and Jutsu editor, developers can now see where animations are referenced in other data types so we can more easily locate unused animations.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Improved Jump, Dash and Falling animations
[/b]Ninja are no longer run kicking your legs mid-air, and falling from heights puts you in a brace position.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Dialogue UI to not have text and choices all the way to the sides of the screen
[/b]This was a player suggestion that I've been meaning to do for awhile now, but having the texts of the dialogue be at the edges of the screen made a lot of sense when Nin was first being designed since the resolution at the time was fixed to 1280x768, now that we allow from widescreen and even ultrawide screen resolutions, it makes sense to center it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Some HUD like targeting, names and outlines on characters are now disabled during dialogues
[/b]More immersive dialogue mode![/p][/*][*][p][b]Added better styling on House and Warp Names
[/b]Gave the House and Warp names a rounded black background so it looks less like a sign and more like UI[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expired Account Tokens on Quick Login menu now prompt you to reauthorize instead of looking like everything is fine
[/b]A player was getting confused when they had the quick login character remain normally, but were getting the token error. Now it prompts you to re-authorize instead of telling you to.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Damage Text is now rendered in the UI system instead of on game render pass so that it can render above names
[/b]I couldn't make damage text move much further because it was being blocked by the names of the target. Now it renders above that![/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Damage Text Speed so that it flies out of characters way
[/b]The way the damage was before it centered very much on the face of the character and didn't move far out. Now it flies out more dramatically. It's for practical reasons, but also looks better.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved the way ImGUI UI is rendered so that it fades to transparency more gracefully
[/b]There's been this longstanding issue for a few years now that when UI fades to transparent, it looks like it turns black before. This meant that when something was alpha 20%, it looked more like 40% and black-ish. This is now gone.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Male Blind Monk Robe Graphics[/b] (Thank you Luhan)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Players no longer emit regeneration text when they are hiding[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Summoning Animation[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Fixed the bug where if you have an enemy targeted, you sometimes attack a different enemy that is also in range and your target changes[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed a Jutsu queue bug where you could get stuck casting a technique [/b](eg. notes.content:
[p]This update brings a much needed rework of perhaps the oldest system in the game - Targeting.[/p][p][/p][h2]Content[/h2][list][*][p][b]Added new Event Prize Shop Item[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/88755fc72a6776eb64f84721ca5da5737bd3e4b7.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Halloween Prize Item - Clown Mask[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/c1a288461ee1be4f1622351e5c1617f3997ef37b.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Hairstyle - Jiang Premium Hairstyle[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/85ee35ff86a8c9facbbbecd408f4f0a3e9a0559b.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Green Ducky Bucket Hat[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/0e6eec52b275fd9916ac2156b2659d0ddbff5c92.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Maki Sushi Hat Recipe to Weaving[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/857ea361914e25d907c27b46b0457462ee6fab7a.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]New Keyboard Targeting System
[/b]The way this worked before was that it cycled through the closest targets to you, but it was never fully accurate in that it was still biased to things that are closer to the top-left of the screen (Position 0,0) in the game engine.

This would mean that targeting would do this...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/93b4639b04ff5f8ddded5726597ac4a93d2a0da4.gif"][/img][/p][p]Even though both targets are equal distance from you and you are facing the enemy you want to target.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/c57c18e57afd513154dd0d1dac723baf2a1f23d2.gif"][/img]The new Targeting system takes into consideration the direction you are moving and facing. If there are no targets there, it considers targets to your left and right, and then your back.

notes.content:
[p]More important fixes and further balance changes. This is all leading up to an effort to make all masteries easier to balance in the long term while making sure they remain unique in playstyles - it's a literal balancing act. I want Tai users to still rely on their jutsu in fights for the most part - holding Z is not fun, but necessary right now. notes.content:
[h3]Free Stat Resets this update[/h3][p]This build contains some major balance changes to the stats system and as such, we will send out Stat Resets to every player account for free. This is part of our effort to continually provide a ethical game service where players are not forced to spend money ever. Since going Live in 2018, whenever large overarching changes are made to balance, players are given free stat resets![/p][p][/p][h2]Balance[/h2][list][*][p][b]HP and Melee Damage Rebalancing[/b]
The above changes combine to reduce the power difference between melee masteries and non-melee masteries, but more importantly reduces the power difference between low level players and higher level players. These changes also make the early game more bearable by making it a lot faster to kill low level mobs and harder to faint to them and make them just a little less weak in general.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Strength & Agility Scaling with Melee Damage reduced by 25%
[/b]This means that the power output between high level WM and Tai players will be lesser than before.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Base Melee Damage increased from 2 to 5
[/b]This means that lower level players, non-Tai and non-WM as well as Tai and WM players will all benefit from a slightly boost in base damage without any stats.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Melee Damage now scales with Level for everyone
[/b]This means that non-Tai and non-WM finally have some usage of Taijutsu regardless of stat point allocation and this potentially opens up more build variety.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fortitude Scaling Decreased by 20%[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Base Health Points Increased from 100 to 200
[/b]These two changes means that more players who want higher damage as they had before for Tai and WM can still get their damage back by allocating more into their Damage stat. While also giving more by default to low level players for better early game progression.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NPC Melee Damage formulas have increased very slightly (matched player formulas)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Everyone gets free stat resets in their mailbox!'[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Content[/h2][list][*][p]Added Ahoge Premium Hairstyle to the Cash Shop (Thank you Bell!)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]Right-click Chatbox Messages to report[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/04466da734a01a3cf04c5032146d100218fbee14.png"][/img][b]
[/b]A highly requested feature. You can now right click messages in the chatbox to report them. I'll also be adding a copy to clipboard option soon for players to slightly more easily translate texts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Re-designed Teams HUD
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/84fd3a9ac2c6ee07e93841d389070030dd8ba866.png"][/img][b]
[/b]A lot less clutter and takes up less screen real estate[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tournament Teammates Indicators[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/6fa41386a0c2f10fafe82a6f83920c171c458b57.png"][/img][/p][p]The game will now draw blue arrow icons above your own teammates in a tournament, like if they were in your party/team[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]If you log into the game on a tile you shouldn't be on, you will now be respawned
[/b]This is mainly for players who haven't logged in for awhile who find that they're now where a big new building has been added for example.[/p][/*][*][p][b]If you defend yourself from someone who has no bounty, it will no longer be counted as a crime[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]NPCs no longer are knocked back on non-critical dash attacks
[/b]This should have changed awhile ago but was missed[/p][/*][*][p][b]/roll messages no longer appear in chatboxes[/b]
They now just appear above the player's head[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved minimap icons
[/b]Friendly NPCs are now white, instead of chests. Chests are still chests.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy AI no longer gives up based on just range[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced respawn time of General Nobu from 20min to 10min[/b] (to match Admiral Mitsuhide respawn time)[/p][/*][*][p]Added new Icon to Gold Ninja Membership in Cash Shop[/p][/*][*][p]Added new art for Luhan's Basuto Suwodo[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Tight Chunin Shirt for Female body[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed being able to zoom out further than you should if you change resolutions while fainted[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed players somehow being in two or more guilds invisibly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Fainted UI saying you won't get Battle Injuries if you respawn on non-arena maps sometimes when you indeed will[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs no longer are knocked back on non-critical hits[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Missing Ninja being able to spawn in village housing districts with a bug[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Workbench and Inventory conflict[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed disabling Music in settings causing lag when sounds play[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed graphics error in Forest of Ambushes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Level 20 Arc NPCs allowing players to warp while in combat[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

[h2]Stability Report[/h2][p]The game service has been much more stable than it was at launch, but as we push updates, expect there may be things we overlook to try to get the game the features it needs. I'm trying to address everyone's gripes, and so it's very much a move fast and break things approach. This is why the game is still marked as an Early Access game. When things are more stable and I'm at liberty to push bigger, more tested updates, I'll resign that title![/p][p]As it stands, everyday, I'm fixing over a dozen bugs and fixing exploits that need to be removed from the game immediately, which is why I have to do these really quick updates so often.[/p][p][/p][h2]256 Steam Players All-Time High[/h2][p]Yesterday, we somehow managed to beat our previously 217 record of Concurrent Steam Players. This was because our Game Masters were hosting the Mist Village Chunin Exams. We saw over 100 players on the same map, and over 320 players in-game during the exams, and stable numbers throughout the rest of the day.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/dbf5a6f46b74c52c4298ed8e98492c5ef2234ffc.png"][/img]Nin Online has frequently been breaking into the Top 100 MMORPG on Steam. Beating out games made by large companies and their multimillion dollar game releases. This isn't even just launch hype! Nin Online is growing since launch, which is uncommon to see in the MMORPG space. Usually there's a huge uptick in players followed by a sharp decline.[/p][p]I don't expect this record to be beaten for a long time now, because these were inflated numbers thanks to an event, and not a normal day. But who knows... If you like Nin Online, please do leave a review and tell your friends about it! [/p][p][/p][h2]Content[/h2][list][*][p][b]Rebalanced Bubble Techniques

notes.title: Update v5.7.8
notes.content:
[p]This is a big update containing needed features for content expansions as well as an cool rework to Cloak of Invisibility Technique and the Sensory system. It's also filled with lots of other goodies! (and of course, bug fixes)[/p][p][/p][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]Warp Techniques (Imprison) can now revive players before warping them
[/b]This was causing the bounty issue when imprisoning enemy ninja. This is now fixed.[/p][/*][*][p](WIP) [b]Kage Approval Rating System
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/e534c3b66b6b6f60a68127d8259d60d931537bb2.png"][/img][/p][p]After the council decides who is an Kage, ninja within the village above level 20 will be able to vote for or against the existing leadership after completing all their daily missions. In the near future, if the approval rating of a Kage is too low, there will be a way or ways to initiate a new election. Missing Ninja of that village can also vote, this is so players cannot just exile whomever dissents them. We will balance how hard it is to do this to make it quite hard. But regardless, this will incentivize players to be good leaders, not exile people for no reason, and for the council to elect likeable and popular leaders.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reworked Cloak of Invisibility Technique and Sensory System
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/51aac59c2fb79fe8a98945b01c286cd5df755844.png"][/img][b]
[/b]This is a major overhaul to one of the first and most important jutsu in the game. Cloak of Invisibility Technique allows for Stealthy gameplay, most vital for feeling ninja.[/p][list][*][p]Visibility of Cloaked Ninja will now depend on your distance to them, if you have higher Chakra, you can detect Cloaked Ninja better as always. If you have higher Intellect, you can hide better.[/p][/*][*][p]Visibility of Cloaked Ninja now get clearer as they are closer to you.[/p][/*][*][p]Cloaked Ninja can target players to see what their sensory range is so they can try to avoid it.[/p][/*][*][p]Cloak of Invisibility Technique now works on NPCs the same way it works on players, targeting the NPC will show you their sensory range, and they can still see you if you are within it.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Added Preliminary Visual Manipulation Genjutsu Support[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/fafa32c25ce0412b686de2ff0cb8a78652e103a6.gif"][/img][b]
[/b]We will introduce basic Genjutsu soon[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Mission Cooldowns for Repeatable Missions
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/7f116862d90f8cb9d0df267c9df8248ee1cf112a.png"][/img][/p][p]So that we can make missions that only are doable every X minutes, hours, days etc. This includes adding special daily missions that will only show up when the cooldown is done.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Crime Reduction to Missions
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/dd3eec75b45d24f7108f97adc6c303a63b53cbb7.png"][/img][b]
[/b]Added support for missions to reduce Crime score. This is for the new prison system so that players can atone for their crimes by completing Prison missions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Music Name UI at bottom left of screen
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/b6f13fd11763b8195e5681ed0aea95fb23a9b1c9.png"][/img]You can disable it in the Settings under Music if you don't like it[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added support for relogging into fainted characters[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]The Hitspark Splashscreen is now animated![/b][/p][/*][*][p](Devs) Added Crime Score checking in Conditional Branches for Events[/p][/*][*][p](Devs) Added Crime Score changing in Commands for Events[/p][/*][*][p](GMs) Added Crime Score changing in Edit Player Menu[/p][/*][*][p](Devs) Added Repeatable Mission filter in Mission Editor[/p][/*][*][p](Devs) Added Alive Target requirement to Jutsu[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Improvements to News on Launch UI
[/b]Improved the usability and design[/p][/*][*][p][b]Redesigned Item Hover Window
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/c0665ffeb55b48537c9d71366ae65f16a8fda408.png"][/img]Now larger, displayers more information and has better styling[/p][/*][*][p][b]"War Crimes" system rebranded as "Crime System"
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/c105d4777e9848070f79d690a76d3259b319b93a.png"][/img][b]
[/b]I'm making the War Crime system that was recently added a lot more encompassing of crimes as a whole. notes.title: Update v5.7.6d
notes.content:
[p]We want Nin Online to be as safe a place for people of all ages and backgrounds. As such, this update goes one step further than our existing system of moderating player reported messages with large language models to instantly ban abusive players. [b]All chats[/b] in Nin Online are now moderated in real-time.[/p][p][/p][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]New & Enhanced AI Moderation System[/b]
Nin Online has always employed state of the art systems to moderate player behavior. It now moderates all chats sent in-game with the latest AI technologies to determine if a player is sending material that is offensive. This can include harassment, usage of slurs and words that are offensive any groups of people and sexual language, and specifically towards minors. There is a 3-strike system where you will receive a verbal warning at first, but punishments will escalate.[/p][/*][*][p][b]War Crimes are now recorded
[/b]Players who kill other players for no reason will now start having a War Crimes stat. This is invisible for now, but this will play into our Military Police system in the near future. War Criminals will be eligible to be imprisoned and Police Forces will be incentivized to imprison war criminals. There is more plans to revamp the entire prison system in the near future.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Item Pickup Range Increased[/b]
You can now pickup items from the tile you are facing in addition to the tile you're standing on. This is to resolve confusion that new players experience because standing on the item to pick it up is not always intuitive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced Minimap Blur
[/b]Players found the blur made it too hard to see the environment even if it was better to look at[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved NPC Attack Animations
[/b]Made them snappier and fixed an issue causing them to use the wrong order of animation frames sometimes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed Healing Text being Red instead of Green[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent Mouse Attack when using UIs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash caused by players having "%" in their Ninja Way[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed NPC Animations being broken since last update[/p][/*][/list]

When I was preparing for launching on Steam, I had no idea it would garner so much attention and that a game like Nin Online could even have this much positivity.[/p][p]We've been seeing daily highs of around 250 or more players and never even falling under 100 throughout the day. Amazing! Your support gives me and the other staff members a lot of motivation to work on the game.[/p][p]The kinds of bug fixes we're dealing with now are very minor compared to what they were almost a month ago since release. The game service has been looking good, with a lot more stability, no crashes in the last couple of days at all. Seems like we just need to maintain this now! This update brings more content, bug fixes and features updates.[/p][p][/p][h2]Content[/h2][list][*][p][b]Added 8 New Maps from Land of Wind to Land of Fire

This is an important feature to have, but has only just been implemented. Players who log in and have swear words in their names will be prompted to change it, otherwise, barred from playing. There might be false flags, so if you feel that you want to keep your name but it's banned, let me know so I can see how I can help you.[/p][/*][*][p](WIP) [b]Wedding Event
[/b]I've partially created a wedding event feature where players can get married by hosting a marriage event. I'm going to experiment with it on small scale for now.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Housing District Fallback Options for each Village
[/b]Players who are no longer able to exit from their houses because they are in the wrong village will be sent to their current village's housing district that is set by developers in the village editor.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Jutsu weapon requirement rework

notes.title: Update v5.7.5b
notes.content:
[p]Over the years, Nin Online has had its fair share of dealing with cheating, hacking and botting. It's a constant battle against those trying to get an unfair advantage over others. We have never relied on third party solutions to combat cheaters, and today we've added further protections against them.[/p][h2][/h2][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]Another Method of Botting Protection Added
[/b]The game has a myriad of ways it prevents against botting. This is just another tool for us to prevent it. We don't add these systems because we want to ban people, we want you to play fairly because that's how Nin Online is meant to be enjoyed. But we understand that if others are cheating, you feel like you're losing out by not doing so. So the more we make sure everyone is playing fairly, the less likely you'd feel inclined to cheat.

This being said, there has already been anti-botting systems in the game, and over the last week 2 people have been banned for using botting tools by our automated system.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added toggle settings for individual Desktop Notifications[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Guild Online Members sorting improvement

notes.content:
[h3]Nin Online hit 10,000 MAU (Monthly Active Users) Today![/h3][p]And we also had the second most active day by many metrics in the game's history. Thank you for playing Nin Online. I hope you're excited about the game's future as there's still so much more planned. If you're interested in joining our community where we take Players Ideas, Bug Reports and where players exchange Guides and more, consider joining our Discord Channel![/p][p][url="https://ninonline.com/discord/" style="button" buttoncolor="#675794"]Nin Online Official Discord Channel[/url][/p][p][/p][h1]What is this Update?[/h1][p]This update fixes lots of bugs, crashes, hanging issues and introduces more polish where it was needed. These updates are aimed at getting Nin Online to a point where it is stable for further expansion of features and content.[/p][p][/p][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]Zoom Levels are now synchronized
[/b]Previously, the zoom levels were buggy and inconsistent. If you had a large monitor, you see way more than you should be able. Nin Online has beautiful 2D pixel art, when you zoom in and see the amount of detail put into the world, you realize how much love was put into it. But playing zoomed in is foolish, so you're forced to play that way because you know others are using every advantage they have.[b]

[/b]No more “screen advantage.” You and every ninja out there will play with the same window into our world - because battles should be decided by skill, not by screen size. 1080p monitor users will see the EXACT same number of pixels as a 4K monitor user aka. 100% fairness across the board. It's not locking at what currently is the 1080p zoom level, it's actually going a little closer than that.[/p][/*][*][p](GMs) [b]IP Ban Management now available in Admin CP > Moderation
[/b]GMs and Admins can now IP Ban specific IP Addresses and remove IP entries easily from within the game, if the system flags an IP for any reason.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Team Mission Sharing no longer limited to 1 a day[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Zoom amount when fainted reduced[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved logout animation[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved map transitions[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved New Advanced Fog Particles to not clash with existing map graphics[/b]

notes.title: Missions Update
notes.content: [p]Nin Online started development early on in very unideal circumstances, the origin of the engine being based all the way back in the 90s, we developed on top of it with the limitations of the times. As such, our missions system was built into the engine early on in 2013, to be very barebones and hacky. This required a ton of unnecessary work on the developer's side to build quest lines. It also limited what we could do heavily.[/p][p][i]This is what our "Quest Editor" looked like just a few years ago... It was built with Winforms... yuck![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/b18027ee2b0c4a10f6ab11552d87a3797be3338d.png"][/img][/p][p]If you look closely, the old mission system actually didn't have any real "objective/task" system. It simply was built by checking scripted variables throughout the way, while the mission log displayed those variables based on a scripted objective text script. The new system actually allows us to build missions in a very intuitive way![/p][p]This week's update is a major overhaul on the Mission System that breaks us free from most of the limitations and opens the door for us to add new kinds of missions in the near future.[/p][p][/p][h2]Objective Location Markers[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/1523b96166bb6619cc164d8828444bdc623ecde6.gif"][/img][/p][p]Nin Online at it's core is not meant to hold your hand all the way, and as such, our objective markers only appear when you're up to 1 map distance away from the mission objective. While I'm not a fan of the brain dead gameplay of following a yellow arrow all the way through, I also understand that it can be hard for new players to get accustomed to this. This method leaves some room for exploration while helping part of the way so you're not completely lost. Some level of reading dialogues is still necessary, but it's much more forgiving.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/5c225e6e75188f0e1bf0ceca19e872b27af90263.gif"][/img][/p][p]When you're not close enough to the objective, you can also press a Location button next to the Mission Objective to reveal on the world map where you should be headed to.[/p][p][/p][h2]Mission Available Markers[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/d6dfcdfdd3dfba21944425c264797cad6ac397ce.gif"][/img][/p][p]Although we introduced this feature awhile back, it was extremely buggy and poorly coded to quickly have the feature added in time for the Steam launch. It's been reworked from the ground up much better![/p][p][/p][h2]Mission Chapters[/h2][p][i]This is what our mission editor looks like now! It has actual objectives![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/4229b2c4590a306b11b289196fca37f0f904a3c0.png"][/img][/p][p]Mission objectives can be segmented into chapters so that the next task isn't revealed, and information is not overloaded onto the player, until the previous objectives are complete. This creates very dynamic missions that can weave storytelling into them![/p][p][/p][h2]New Kinds of Objectives[/h2][p]So far, I've added a few new kinds of objectives. The first kind being exploration Objectives. These allow us to task the player to visit a certain map or to spend X seconds on the map. The second kind is discovering items, which is similar to Item objectives, but you don't lose them.[/p][p]We're planning to add more in the near future such as escort, crafting and leveling objectives. We're open to suggestions on more! Join our [url="https://ninonline.com/discord"]Discord channel[/url] where we have a Player Ideas submission platform![/p][p][/p][h2]Other changes[/h2][p]This Missions Update also resolves a lot of past issues with missions and NPC dialogues, and as we transition to this new system more fully it should eliminate issues where players could get soft locked on their mission progress. I've also manually went through all existing missions multiple times in my own testing to make sure missions are working, are of higher quality than before in writing in some cases and give clearer directions.[/p][p]On top of this, NPC Kill missions are now completely independent from the old variables system, which means missions will no longer clash with one another when they both ask you to kill the same enemy type.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/f5180a21231c689f4368d8b2607e9f044d766823.png"][/img][/p][p](Developer) Mission objectives can be marked to remove items when the mission is completed.[/p][p](Developer) We've also added more substantial debugging tools for admins to help solve mission issues for players just incase.[/p][p](Developer) Our NPC/Event system can now also check mission objectives and if players have missions directly instead of relying on the Variables/Switches system.[/p][p][/p][h2]Other Updates[/h2][p]Of course, missions is not all I've updated![/p][p][/p][h3]Added Borderless Fullscreen Mode[/h3][p]Much improved speed for going back and forth between fullscreen. This is now the default mode for new downloaded clients. It's a much more pleasant experience than the old fullscreen mode and also does not have compatibility issues with Windows HDR whereas the old fullscreen mode turns Windows HDR off.[/p][p][/p][h3]Added Video Playback Support to the Nin Engine[/h3][p]Nin Online's engine now supports playing video files. This is used in a few ways now, a new cutscene player, game guide banners and Jutsu previews in the Mastery Selection menu.[/p][p][/p][h3]Added a new (skippable) introduction video to the game[/h3][p]This replaces the old introduction cutscene where you had to click through it.[/p][p][/p][h3]Reworked Volume Scaling[/h3][p]The game's volume always had an issue where only like 10% or less volumes were really playable. Otherwise the game was way too loud. This means you might have to readjust your volume settings though![/p][p][/p][h3]Other Changes[/h3][p]Added Keybinds for Hotkey Bar Cycling and PM Name Input Shortcut[/p][p]Improved NPC Layout[/p][p]New Server Selection Screen Icons[/p][p]Added players online count to server selection screen[/p][p]Added Video Playback Support to the Nin Engine[/p][p]Combined Shop with Inventory window for a neater experience when you are in a shop[/p][p]When players are AFK, they now have their eyes closed[/p][p](Developer) Added search boxes for Variable Selectors and Switch selectors in editor[/p][p](Developer) Added Mission Objective Selector Widget[/p][p](Developer) Added "Self" options for Animation and Chat Bubble Event Commands[/p][p](Developer) Added Event Conditional Branches to check individual Mission Objectives[/p][p](Developer) Added Event Commands to modify status of Mission Objectives[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p]Fixed chatbox bugginess where it would stop scrolling to the bottom or glitch near it[/p][p]Fixed NPCs finishing casting their Jutsu even after dying[/p][p]Fixed being able to walk between Event System / NPC Dialogues[/p][p]Fixed the dialogue box disappearing between NPC Dialogue texts[/p][p]Fixed being able to keep invisibility when next jutsu is queued before Cloak is cast[/p][p]Fixed the bug where when you talk to NPCs your camera flies far away and prevented it from happening ever again.[/p][p]Fixed quick logins not saving if you login into a instanced map[/p][p]Fixed Ctrl + Tab showing the ImGui alt-tab like menu[/p][p]Fixed a bug where casting a jutsu when you just entered a map can get your jutsu queue stuck[/p][p]Fixed instacast jutsu not showing Casting Jutsu pose (like breaking kick)[/p][p]Fixed Steam Deck crashes[/p][p]Fixed the way client rounds up/down sell price for items to be consistent with server[/p][p]Fixed Chat Channels tooltip clashing with Map Zone tooltip[/p][p]Fixed Barber/Hair Dresser NPC allowing you to change your hair to bald for free by not selecting a hair style[/p][p]Fixed NPC Yori's artwork moving oddly when facing left[/p]

notes.title: Test Server Opened
notes.content:
[h2][b]Beta Testing[/b][/h2][p]If you'd like to participate in beta testing the next version of Nin Online, you can now do so by changing your branch on Steam to the beta branch. By testing and providing feedback on Discord, you'll let us know in advance if there are any errors. We are currently beta testing on the Snake server.[/p][p][/p][h2]How to participate?[/h2][p]Simply go to [b]Properties > Betas > Beta Participation [/b]and select the beta mode. Once you choose this, your client will update.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/e30930bd36f16b0558613f874421804d006cf0b6.png"][/img][/p][p]Next, select the Snake server instead of Toad when logging in.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/5765d19d58609e92e8d630f32c8c167e30060026.png"][/img][/p][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][p][b]Reworked entire Mission System
[/b]This requires vigorous testing, I've personally been testing all the missions in the game myself for days now, but there might still be issues.[/p][p]The old mission system was very hacky and didn't allow for much flexibility. Objectives were very very hacked. The Mission system now supports mission chapters, different types of objectives like Kill NPC, Kill Player, Return to the Quest Giver, etc. (And more in the future)[/p][p]It also comes with Mission Directions markers aka. Quest Indicators. With direction arrows as long as you're 1 map or less away from the quest objective.[/p][p]Also completely replaced the buggy mission indicators from a few patches ago with this new system completely.[/p][p]I've also fixed a ton of old mission bugs, badly written dialogues and more.[/p][p][b]New Server Selection Screen Icons[/b][/p][p]New art, more dynamic, can be translated[/p][p][b]Added Video Playback Support to the Nin Engine[/b][/p][p][b]Added a new (skippable) introduction video to the game
[/b]This replaces the entire spam click to get through intro that talks about the ninja world.[/p][p][b]Mastery Selection Menu loads videos of Jutsu instantly now instead of slowly loading GIFs[/b][/p][p][b]Game Guides now load banners instantly and are using videos instead of GIFs[/b][/p][p][b]Combined Shop with Inventory window for a neater experience when you are in a shop[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Developer Changes[/h3][p][b]Upgraded Mission Debug Menu for Editing Players[/b][/p][p][b]Added Borderless Fullscreen Mode
[/b]Much improved speed for going back and forth between Fullscreen. Also this is now the default mode for new downloaded clients.[/p][p][b]Reworked Volume Scaling
[/b]The game's volume always had an issue where only like 10% or less volumes were really playable. Otherwise the game was way too loud.[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p]Fixed the bug where when you talk to NPCs your camera flies far away and prevented it from happening ever again.[/p][p]Fixed quick logins not saving if you login into a instanced map[/p][p]Fixed NPCs dying but still casting their jutsu they started while alive[/p][p]Fixed a jutsu queue exploit with invisibility[/p][p]Fixed Ctrl + Tab showing the ImGui alt-tab like menu[/p][p]Fixed a bug where casting a Jutsu when you just entered a map can get your Jutsu queue stuck[/p][p]Fixed instant cast jutsu not showing Casting Jutsu pose (like breaking kick)[/p][p]Fixed Steam Deck crashes[/p][p][/p][h2]Known Issues[/h2][p]Fullscreen and Window mode switching is broken through the Settings menu[/p]

notes.title: Update 5.6.8k
notes.content: [p]I'm happy to report that a lot of the players who were suffering from lag issues when there were a lot of players online have been reporting that their issues are resolved with the server upgrade. This regular patch addresses small concerns voiced over the last couple of days! These are important changes that need to go out while I'm still working on bigger changes.[/p][p][/p][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]Auto Assign Stat Points[/b][/p][p]Auto-assign Stats Points button added for New Players. This feature is meant to introduce players to stats when they first begin playing. From level 1-10 it recommends things that will help you get to your first mastery faster. Once you have your first mastery, it begins recommending stats based on the default path for that mastery. It does also warn you that it's not the best possible build, but just a better start than randomly assigning it.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40800315/b59d3393a0bac9d9d82e982267685d9661ffdd62.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Reset button added to the Stat Points assignment area as well. Previously, you'd have to re-open the Ninja menu to reset it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Moved Web API server to new server.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized login packets.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed game time and event schedule synchronization (It's now back synchronized with EST)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mastery selection menu crashing on Steam Deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed client using outdated IP to try to connect when using Quick Login if the server changes IP addresses.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Jutsu Cast Pose not being used when Jutsu is instantly cast.[/p][/*][*][p]Ensured server no longer uses Window's "Quick Edit Mode" which caused the server to freeze.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Buffs not being sent to player on login, causing Battle Injuries to be present but not visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Name Change item allowing players to make names too long, which would lock them out of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed developers saving maps causing desync for players on the map.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Fixed game time and event schedule synchronization (It's now back synchronized with EST)

Ensured server no longer uses Window's "Quick Edit Mode" which caused the server to freeze.
Fixed Buffs not being sent to player on login, causing Battle Injuries to be present but not visible.
Fixed Name Change item allowing players to make names too long, which would lock them out of the game.
Fixed developers saving maps causing desync for players on the map.

tags.feature: Nin Online no longer requires .NET 6 installed to run. It is self-contained. This also means Steamdecks should now be able to run it!
OpenGL 3.3 Fallback support for when OpenGL 4.1 is not compatible. This should alleviate the need for third party software to use software rendering for older devices.

tags.balance_change: Lowered required kills for all early game mob killing missions by about 10-20.

tags.feature: Level 30 Arc Mission Giver NPC now appears consistently to other arcs.
Talking to Mission Assignment Desk now immediately triggers Welcome to Village Questlines.
Tournament UI no longer appears when you are on different maps.
Consistently now, you should be able to pass through all players unless combat status is active.
Added a "Are you enjoying Nin Online?" notification that appears when you reach level 11 and 20 for Steam Reviews.
Added new graphics to be implemented for content soon.
Jumps are now more responsive, you will jump before the Leap indicator appears.
Separate Keybind for Leaps added if you want (completely restores old jump)
'H' Keybind for Hiding UI now only hides the UI when you have it held down.
